location.quote: Our corporate headquarters are located in Menlo Park, California.

note: Headquarters from the FY2025 Form 10-K (Item 2) of Meta Platforms, Inc. facebook.com is Meta's general service domain (login, sharing dialogs, and the APIs of Meta's own apps, e.g. gateway.facebook.com and b-graph.facebook.com used by the Facebook app). A lookup to it is a catalogue match only, not a known tracking endpoint, so it is COMPANY_SERVICE and no consent check counts it. Meta's tracking endpoints keep their own entries: graph.facebook.com and connect.facebook.net (Facebook SDK app events, pixel) and an.facebook.com (Audience Network).

location.quote: Our corporate headquarters are located in Menlo Park, California.

note: Headquarters from the FY2025 Form 10-K (Item 2) of Meta Platforms, Inc. fbcdn.net is Meta's content delivery network: its hosts (scontent, static, video) serve the images, video and static files of Meta apps and embeds, so a lookup to it is content delivery, not tracking by itself. It was split from the SOCIAL facebook.com entry so that photo and video loading in Instagram or Facebook is not reported as a tracker; Meta's tracking endpoints (graph.facebook.com, connect.facebook.net, an.facebook.com) keep their categories. A CNAME alias to fbcdn.net is ordinary infrastructure and never decides a classification.
